features.name: Reactions: when this happens, do that
features.what: The world notices what the player does (a kill, a read note, an arrival) and answers in small, readable ways.

features.name: One button for everything
features.what: E, F, Space, Enter or one button talks, opens, trades, goes through doors and starts a fight; it also turns note pages and closes speech.

features.name: A quiet screen, WASD and a calm step
features.what: The how-to-move line goes after your first step, fight buttons show only near a monster, messages sit in a small corner panel, WASD walks, Trade closes with E or F.

features.name: Levels, or learning by doing
features.what: The hero grows: experience and levels (classic), or skills that improve with use.

features.name: Monsters and cozy fights
features.what: Monsters with health and bite, bump to strike, and a way to lose that never ends the game.

features.name: Books and notes you find
features.what: Notes, letters and books lying in the world, in chests, or given by people; kept and re-readable.

features.name: Items, a bag and a shop
features.what: Things to find, carry, use, buy and sell, including keep-forever tools.

features.name: Fog of war
features.what: Floors are dark until you walk them, and the map remembers what you saw.

features.name: Generated floors (drawn at build time)
features.what: `vefr delve` draws connected dungeon floors from a seed and wires their stairs.

features.name: publish, look and probe
features.what: Developer verbs: post a build to the gallery, screenshot the game and list text over the map, fire story events and read why they happened.

features.name: A game's interface as pictures
features.what: A folder of pictures that paints the buttons, panels and bars in a game's own look.

features.name: A new descent every run
features.what: Floors drawn fresh each run from a seed, by the same generator in Python and the browser.

features.name: Locks, keys and guardians
features.what: A locked stair opened by a key a tougher monster carries; a ladder of guardians ending at the act's boss.

features.name: The album
features.what: One record of what you have met and found, and a sticker album that fills in as you play.

features.name: Gear in five slots
features.what: Wear and hold things that change your health and attack.

features.name: A story in acts
features.what: One act ends and the next begins, with its own map and mood.
